title: Vikrant Massey and Sheetal Thakur: A Bollywood Love Story Written Off-Screen
excerpt: From meeting on the sets of Broken But Beautiful to building a family together, Vikrant Massey and Sheetal Thakur's relationship has become one of Bollywood's most grounded love stories.
body:
• Vikrant Massey and Sheetal Thakur met on the sets of ALT Balaji's Broken But Beautiful and began dating after feeling an instant connection.
  • The couple registered their marriage on Valentine's Day 2022 and held a traditional ceremony in Shahtalai, Himachal Pradesh, on February 18.
  • They welcomed their first son, Vardaan, on February 7, 2024, adding a new chapter to their journey together.
  • Massey won a National Award for his acclaimed performance in 12th Fail, with Sheetal by his side throughout the career-defining moment.

In an industry that trades in manufactured romance, Vikrant Massey and Sheetal Thakur's love story has unfolded with a quiet sincerity that feels distinctly un-Bollywood. The Better India recently profiled the couple's journey, calling it "better than any Bollywood script," and the description is hard to argue with.

The two actors met on the sets of ALT Balaji's Broken But Beautiful in 2018, a series about fractured relationships that, ironically, sparked a very real one. Massey has spoken about feeling an instant connection, while Sheetal has said she sensed early on that he was "the father of my kids." What followed was not a whirlwind Bollywood romance but something more measured: years of quiet support through career uncertainties, financial difficulties, and the slow grind of building a life in Mumbai.

From Chawl to Spotlight

Understanding Massey's love story requires understanding where he came from. Born into a modest Delhi family, Massey started his career on television with shows like Balika Vadhu and Dharam Veer before making the difficult leap to films. The transition was anything but smooth. He has spoken openly about the years of struggle, the constant auditions, and the financial pressure of trying to establish himself in an industry that offers no guarantees.

Sheetal, a Himachali actress who had appeared in Punjabi cinema including the well-received Bambukat, understood the industry's demands firsthand. Reports suggest she provided financial support during Massey's leaner years, a detail he has acknowledged with gratitude in interviews.

A Wedding That Stayed True to Their Roots

After a private roka ceremony in December 2019, the couple registered their marriage on Valentine's Day, February 14, 2022, before hosting a traditional wedding ceremony four days later in Shahtalai, a small town in Himachal Pradesh's Bilaspur district. The choice of location reflected their roots rather than their rising profiles.

The wedding was an intimate affair featuring organic and eco-friendly decor, attended by close family and friends. There were no magazine-exclusive photo deals or choreographed Instagram reveals. The couple's wedding photos, shared later, showed two people who looked genuinely present in the moment rather than performing for cameras.

From Lovers to Parents

On February 7, 2024, Vikrant and Sheetal welcomed their first child, a son they named Vardaan. Massey marked the occasion with characteristic warmth, posting that they were "bursting with joy and love."

Fatherhood appears to have deepened Massey's already reflective approach to life and work. On Father's Day, he shared a post dedicated to "all the men who try, fail and yet try again to be the father they've always wanted to be," thanking Sheetal for "giving me the honour to be one."

"Happy Anniversary my A1 from Day 1."

— Vikrant Massey, on his fourth wedding anniversary with Sheetal Thakur, February 2026

The 12th Fail Breakthrough

Massey's career breakthrough came with 12th Fail, a sleeper hit that earned him a National Award and widespread critical acclaim. Photos from the award ceremony show Sheetal beside him during the milestone, a visual reminder that the professional triumph was also a family one.

After the intensity of that period, Massey took a brief sabbatical from acting before returning with Vishal Bhardwaj's O'Romeo in February 2026. He is also set to make his OTT comeback with the series Musafir Cafe, co-starring Vedika Pinto and Mahima Makwana, while stepping into the role of producer for the first time.

In an industry where relationships are often as disposable as box-office receipts, Massey and Thakur have built something that lasts by keeping it simple, keeping it honest, and keeping the cameras at arm's length when it matters.
nri_angle: Vikrant Massey's journey from television to National Award winner resonates with diaspora audiences who followed his rise through OTT platforms popular abroad.
